why: Round 2 review, must-fix 1: a six-turn dialogue whose answers all carry 的 and 是, the two commonest characters in the language. The pair detector's function-word test let every turn through, so the speakers became the only two cards and nine real words were thrown away. The speakers repeat, and a vocabulary list never explains the same word twice.
